Name: Mission ID
Description: Numeric ID of the currently loaded native mission. This does not select or start a mission.
RestoreBehavior: Observation only. Missing or unconfigured mission objects have no valid value.

Evidence.Finding: Native inline objects and registry identify the current mission; clock uses 60 ticks per second. Values are read only after exact object, phase and range checks.
Evidence.Level: Full fresh dedicated IDA assembly; isolated synthetic guards; no live test.

Name: Restart as Countdown
Description: Restarts the active native mission timer as a countdown, including a currently running count-up. Requires stable unpaused gameplay and a living current player. The 1..3599 second range keeps the normal HUD below one hour. A one-time native restart; disconnect and Disable All do not undo it. Normal timeout events, rewards and mission outcomes still apply. An already-played final-seconds HUD warning may not repeat, because native restart does not reset its display latches.
RestoreBehavior: A one-time native restart; disconnect and Disable All do not undo it. Normal timeout events, rewards and mission outcomes still apply. An already-played final-seconds HUD warning may not repeat, because native restart does not reset its display latches.

Evidence.Finding: Native argument seconds>0 selects countdown; timer index0 and active widget avoid HUD construction. Exact code and fresh mission identity are checked before one synchronous call.
Evidence.Level: 81 native instructions independently reviewed; 1092 isolated checks passed; no live test.

Name: Restart as Count-up
Description: Restarts the active native mission timer from zero, including a countdown, using its existing configured count-up limit. Zero means no configured limit. Native display caps at 3599.983 seconds; a configured limit above this cap does not dispatch timeout through this clock path. A one-time native restart; disconnect and Disable All do not undo it. Normal timeout events, rewards and mission outcomes still apply. An already-played final-seconds HUD warning may not repeat, because native restart does not reset its display latches.
RestoreBehavior: A one-time native restart; disconnect and Disable All do not undo it. Normal timeout events, rewards and mission outcomes still apply. An already-played final-seconds HUD warning may not repeat, because native restart does not reset its display latches.

Evidence.Finding: Native zero argument selects count-up from Timer+36; the configured value must be nonnegative and fit signed32-bit multiplication by60. The existing limit is not changed.
Evidence.Level: 81 native instructions independently reviewed; 1092 isolated checks passed; no live test.
